sections.html: Nannostomus marylinae is a comparatively small, slender species of pencil fish that becomes only 2.5 – 3 cm long. The absolutely peaceful species likes to swim around in company of conspecifics and is perfectly suited for small, so-called nano tanks.

A beautiful, only very rarely available species of pencil fish was imported from Venezuela. Some days after arrival the fish showed two remarkable, reddish-brown spots in the middle of the body, a coloration said to be typical for N. minimus. However, the fish later lost those spots. The original description of N. marylinae was checked, and the two spots are also present in preserved specimens of N. marylinae, so the fish are confirmed to belong to that species.
